additional_info.subject: ID0482665-DC/Si-D/IT- [Y2/S1 313508370009] Log Check CRM:03288000456
additional_info.body:
Dear Maria,
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support.
Following your report, and after checking the charging session, we see that indeed the stop transaction request was ignored by the charger.
In this log you are able to see that the stop transaction request was accepted by the OCPP of the charger, but after that the network became unreachable for the charger, and the request could not be executed.
After this the client requested a reboot of the charger, and this made the mainbreaker trip. After this, no request could be executed.
We hope this answered your question.
Please provide us with feedback, so we are able to close the ticket.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
